# SpikingMOT

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spike-driven multi-object tracker architecture that integrates spiking neural networks for detection and association of objects across time. Demonstrates feasibility of complex temporal reasoning (tracking) entirely within neuromorphic constraints, advancing iNEST's capability for real-time scene understanding.
